units.source_text: 这一天，桃园式部卿亲王逝世了。

en.t: On this day, Prince Momozono, the Minister of Ceremonial Affairs, passed away.

units.source_text: 噩耗传来，冷泉帝又吃一惊，觉得这世间凶灾接踵而生，越发可忧了。

en.t: When the dreadful news arrived, Emperor Reizei was startled once again, and he felt that calamities in the world were following one after another, making matters still more troubling.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣看见皇上如此忧伤，便不返二条院去，常住宫中，与皇上亲密谈心。

en.t: Seeing the Emperor so sorrowful, Genji, the Minister of the Center, did not return to the Nijo estate, but stayed constantly at court and spoke with His Majesty in close confidence.

units.source_text: 皇上对他言道：“我恐寿命不永了，何以近来心情如此颓丧，天下又如此不太平。

en.t: The Emperor said to him, "I fear that my life may not be long; why else have I felt so dejected of late, while the realm too is so unsettled?

units.source_text: 万方多难，教我不胜忧惧。

en.t: Troubles arise on every side, and I can hardly bear my anxiety and fear.

units.source_text: 我颇思引退，母后在世之时，我恐使她伤心，不敢提及。

en.t: I have often thought of withdrawing, but while the Empress Mother was alive, I feared it would grieve her and dared not mention it.

units.source_text: 今已无所顾虑，我欲及早让位，以便安心度日。”

en.t: Now that I have nothing left to hold me back, I wish to abdicate soon, so that I may pass my days in peace."

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣骇然答道：“此事如何使得！

en.t: Genji, the Minister of the Center, answered in alarm, "How could such a thing possibly be permitted?

units.source_text: 天下之太平与否，未必由于政治之长短。

en.t: Whether the world is at peace or not does not necessarily depend on the merits or faults of the government.

units.source_text: 自古圣代明时，亦难免有凶恶之事。

en.t: Since ancient times, even in enlightened and virtuous reigns, terrible events have been impossible to avoid.

units.source_text: 圣明天子时代发生意外变乱，在中国也有其例，在我国亦复如是。

en.t: There are examples in China of unexpected upheavals occurring in the age of a wise and brilliant sovereign, and the same has been true in our own country.

units.source_text: 何况最近逝世之人，多半是高龄长寿，享尽天年者。

en.t: Moreover, most of those who have died recently were people of advanced age and long life, who had lived out their allotted years.
Your Majesty need not be anxious or afraid."

units.source_text: 便列举种种事例，多方劝慰。

en.t: He then cited many examples and comforted the Emperor in every possible way.

units.source_text: 作者女流之辈，不敢侈谈天下大事。

en.t: The author, being a woman, does not presume to speak expansively about the great affairs of the realm.

units.source_text: 略举一端，亦不免越俎之嫌。

en.t: Even to mention one small part of them risks seeming to overstep her proper place.
